claim_boundary: local geometry along actual one-cue history differences; no memory use, causal route mechanism, belief, adaptation or global stability claim
history_support: all64 histories; all32 distinct pairs per flip, both orientations; no selected backgrounds
control: two fixed isotropic unit directions per seed from RNG(seed*10000+direction_seed); requested L2 radius=f*norm(d), same source anchor; actual q32 delta retained
orientation: positive chord fractions only; reversed natural pair is the counterpart orientation; no negative extrapolation called natural
reachability: f=1 endpoints independently replayed histories; f<1 controlled interpolants not claimed reachable
confound: early informative versus final neutral flips differ in cue position AND reliability; no reliability-specific mechanism inference
transition: identical seed weights; blank steps; runtime index38 and auxiliary state reset inside every native32/float64/JVP call
sanity: all source baselines independently replayed; f=1 chord input/output must exactly equal counterfactual native checkpoint/continuation
response_validity: nonzero effective delta and induced64 response >=10*precision_floor
falsifier: precision-valid natural endpoints exceed0.1 relative curvature error; do not infer failure from invalid cells
comparison: within seed/source/flip/horizon/fraction, compare natural curvature error with mean of two norm-matched random errors; retain both orientations as dependent observations
decision: if natural chords resemble random controls, stop local-geometry tuning and inspect upstream representation formation; if natural-only failures, characterize direction/channel composition first
independent_unit: four fresh parameter seeds; histories, orientations, fractions, directions and horizons dependent within seed
